basics.name: Luciano Fiorin
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 17+ years of hands-on experience building and evolving production software across startups, enterprise platforms and international teams. Specializes in the TypeScript ecosystem — React, Next.js, Node.js, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, microfrontends and developer tooling — and combines platform engineering with AI, focused on agent orchestration, workflow systems, LLM-powered content processing and AI-assisted development. Leads engineering squads, mentors developers and contributes to architecture while staying hands-on with implementation and performance. MSc in Computer Science with research in AI and pattern recognition.

work.name: Zephyr Cloud
work.summary:
- Redesigned dependency graph calculation, indexing, caching and rendering strategies for large federated application graphs, improving responsiveness for an environment with roughly 400 microfrontends.
- Optimized and extended Webpack and Rspack integrations, improving SSG and SSR support within the deployment and Module Federation ecosystem and reducing file upload and build times.
- Contributed to platform-level architecture decisions: microfrontend orchestration, dependency management, deployment, versioning, developer tooling and performance.
- Implemented multi-cloud deployment systems for replicated deployments across cloud providers, plus criteria/tag-based deployment to automate environment-specific processes.
- Built a platform-wide supervisory agent with shared context that monitors activity across specialized agents, and created context-document-driven agents for collaborative, goal-oriented workflows.
- Implemented automation for actions and events through a drag-and-drop workflow system with 100+ actions, events and integrations in the AI Platform, while optimizing chat response time.

work.name: JoVE
work.summary:
- Extended the indexed search architecture with Elasticsearch fuzzy matching and pagination while maintaining performance characteristics of a large scientific and academic system.
- Designed and implemented an AI-assisted content processing pipeline that prepared and filtered article and video data for external AI model analysis, storing enriched results to improve search.
- Migrated the frontend to React and Next.js, added Node.js backend services for internal monitoring tools, and refactored multiple modules to reduce code footprint and modularize migrated code.
- Led a squad of ~5 senior engineers for one year, coordinating delivery, architecture, code reviews and resolving technical disagreements.
- Shipped an evaluation and questionnaire system used by professors worldwide, and drove test-coverage initiatives across platform modules using external AI models.

work.name: Right Balance
work.summary:
- Supervised ~7 engineers across international client allocations, providing technical guidance and maintaining consistent delivery quality.
- Ran regular 1:1s covering feedback, mentoring and professional development.
- Prepared monthly reports for consultancy leadership and the CEO on engineer performance, project progress and client allocation.
- Intercepted and resolved internal client problems autonomously, exercising conflict resolution without escalation.

work.name: Groundbreaker
work.summary:
- Contributed to architectural modernization from a monolith toward independently deployable microservices, microfrontends, serverless services and event-driven workflows for a real estate system transacting millions of dollars annually.
- Implemented Module Federation across dozens of independently deployed applications so repositories and components could evolve and deploy separately.
- Contributed to AWS serverless infrastructure using Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, Cognito and Terraform.
- Migrated the backend from Ruby to Node.js and a serverless architecture, and the frontend to React and Next.js with microfrontends.
- Implemented payment and subscription management across backend services, data synchronization, CI/CD, deployment automation and production architecture.

work.name: VivaWorks
work.summary:
- Led and delivered multiple products and major platform initiatives from concept to production: real-time chat, mobile applications, conference-room systems, TV applications and reusable platform modules for a B2B social network system.
- Delivered an MVP real-time communication product from concept through production, and built conference-room and TV applications from scratch.
- Developed mobile applications in ~4 months with Flutter alongside the existing web platform and backend services.
- Designed real-time, event-driven communication features with Node.js and React, helping stabilize the broader platform architecture.
- Contributed to main-product stability as it grew from first client company to 300+ paying companies plus free/entry plans, and integrated external educational, payment, video and monitoring systems.

work.name: Multibot
work.summary:
- Owned core technical direction as principal developer from initial architecture through production for an investment recommendation product originated as an MVP within VivaWorks.
- Architected a Node.js and AWS serverless backend and React platform for a recurring-revenue product; delivered the first MVP in ~3 months and grew it to 300+ customers.
- Built the SaaS platform from concept to production, helping establish a profitable business operated for roughly four years.
- Participated in product and board-level strategy, shaping the roadmap and implementing stock exchange, financial and payment integrations.

work.name: UTFPR
work.summary:
- Taught programming languages and database systems, including Java, Python, JavaScript, PHP, C++, MySQL and MongoDB.
- Mentored students for programming competitions, strengthening problem-solving and coding skills.
- Evaluated graduation projects with emphasis on architecture and code quality, giving constructive feedback.

work.name: VivaWorks
work.summary:
- Developed collaborative web applications and real-time communication features using PHP/Zend, Node.js, React, JavaScript and PostgreSQL.
- Contributed to modernization of legacy systems by introducing Node.js and React alongside the existing PHP platform.
- Built and integrated backend and frontend features across collaborative communication and business workflows.

education.summary: Research focused on dynamic ensemble selection and classifier optimization for music genre recognition.
